item.title: Disney Imagineering Debuts Next-Generation Robotic Character, Olaf
item.description:
📝 Contributed By Kyle Laughlin SVP R&D Technology & Engineering, Walt Disney Imagineering Disneyland Paris saw a groundbreaking moment today, where Bruce Vaughn, President and Chief Creative Officer of Walt Disney Imagineering, and Natacha Rafalski, Présidente of Disneyland Paris, introduced a next-generation robotic character representing Olaf, the beloved snowman from Walt Disney Animation Studios’ Frozen. Prototype-completed design varies. @disneyparks From screen to reality, the next-generation robotic character representing Olaf marks a new chapter in Disney character innovation ☃️ ♬ original sound – Disney Parks Our roots are in animation with Walt Disney pioneering early hand-drawn films and today, Walt Disney Animation Studios and Pixar Animation Studios continue that tradition.
🔗 Read more: https://disneyparksblog.com/disney-experiences/robotic-olaf-marks-new-era-of-disney-innovation/

item.title: ONNX Runtime and CoreML May Silently Convert Your Model to FP16
item.description:
📝 TLDR Running an ONNX model in ONNX RunTime (ORT) with the CoreMLExecutionProvider may change the predictions your model makes implicitly and you may observe differences when running with PyTorch on MPS or ONNX on CPU. Why am I Using ONNX and ONNX RunTime. These graphs are called ONNX graphs.
🔗 Read more: https://ym2132.github.io/ONNX_MLProgram_NN_exploration
